text:
🗳️ Election update: 98.8% of voting districts are counted. The IEC declares the official results on Sunday. All figures are provisional until then.

National (proportional ballot): ANC 31.1%, DA 24.7%, MK 9.6%, EFF 6.3%, ActionSA 6.0%. Turnout is about 52%, according to the IEC.

🌾 Mangaung is fully counted, and no party has a majority. The ANC has 36 of 101 seats and the DA 33, so a coalition needs 51. The EFF (9), FF Plus (6) and PA (4) could decide who governs.

The other metros (proportional ballot):
🏙️ Johannesburg: DA 35.6%, ANC 20.0%, ActionSA 17.3%
🏛️ Tshwane: DA 34.0%, ActionSA 23.5%, ANC 20.2%
🏭 Ekurhuleni: DA 30.8%, ANC 21.5%, ActionSA 20.1%
🌴 eThekwini: MK 39.7%, DA 24.8%, ANC 16.5%
🏞️ Buffalo City: ANC 41.9%, UDM 18.4%, DA 16.9%
🌅 Nelson Mandela Bay: DA 44.4%, ANC 25.5%
🌊 Cape Town is the only metro where one party (the DA) has more than half the vote.

What it means for your pocket: in seven of the eight metros, coalition deals will decide who becomes mayor, and who sets your rates, water and electricity tariffs for the next five years.

Which party do you think will be the kingmaker in your metro? 👇
